# Source

`include/nlohmann/json.hpp`: nlohmann/json 3.11.3 single header, release asset
https://github.com/nlohmann/json/releases/download/v3.11.3/json.hpp
(sha256 `9bea4c8066ef4a1c206b2be5a36302f8926f7fdc6087af5d20b417d0cf103ea6`, MIT).
The two `.cmake` files are a minimal package config so `find_package(nlohmann_json)` finds the header.
